reviewed: Actual real-photo triptychs for 23 item groups and five additional camera views; original metallic toaster is preserved.
changes: Counter stone reprojected from actual photographs
Planar backsplash extended to close the seam
Canister decoration, caddy, bottle labels and tea/coffee surfaces photo-grounded
Phone fixed at physical support height with improved photo silhouette fit and photographed controls
Blue creamer constrained to the visible photo silhouette
Frog sparse reconstruction moved rigidly inward instead of distorted by point clipping
limitations: Frog statues remain sparse and approximate; this is not an exact new model
Blue creamer has a generic opening and handle; its size is estimated
Phone controls are photo-projected and its cord is simplified
Knife handles and their occluded intersections remain approximate
Hidden counter/backsplash texture uses photographic infill
Some original surrounding scan geometry and view gaps remain
Gaussian appearance is fixed lighting, not fully relightable PBR
size_review: Private audit explicitly reviews the 5.1 cm miniature creamer and 31.6 cm desk phone including handset/cord; original generic size thresholds would flag these. Support, counter, wall and overlap checks remain unchanged.
